items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You have to talk to his wife. Eh? His wife speaks French. Not him. I'd like to see her.

ctx.x: All the time. I had people in that little 2x4 room. Taking pictures up there, yeah, so many. Um, did that hurt your eyes? No, I run water, you know, all the time. You're just scared, that's all. Because, uh... No, my eyes run water because I'm so young, you know, I'm 94 years old. I don't believe it. Well, you're very polite indeed. You don't believe it. Viscuit au croix, vous serez venir m'encher?
You have to talk to his wife. Eh? His wife speaks French. Not him. I'd like to see her.
Maybe that won't bother you so much over there. Put it over here. Then you won't have to look at it.
